Relación directa:

```{r}
gasto <- rexp(n = 50, rate = 1/1200000)
error <- rnorm(n = 50, mean = 200000, sd = 200000)
ingreso <- 1.3 * gasto + error
plot(gasto, ingreso)
abline(lm(ingreso ~ gasto))
```

```{r}
cor(gasto, ingreso)
```


$$
r = \frac{\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_i^{n}(x_i-\overline{x})(y_i-\overline{y})}{S_xS_y}

$$
$$
S_x = \frac{\sum_i^{n}(x_i-\overline{x})^2}{n-1}

$$


```{r}
datos <- data.frame(gasto, ingreso)
```



Relación inversa:

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Simulate GDP per capita
n <- 200
gdp <- sort(rlnorm(n, meanlog = 9, sdlog = 1))  # Ensure GDP is increasing

# Strictly decreasing child mortality using a smooth inverse function
# High at low GDP, low at high GDP (monotonic relationship)
max_mortality <- 180
min_mortality <- 2
child_mortality <- max_mortality / (log(gdp)^1.5) + runif(n, -3, 3)
child_mortality <- pmax(child_mortality, min_mortality)

# Data frame
df <- data.frame(GDP_per_capita = gdp, Child_Mortality = child_mortality)

# Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df, aes(x = GDP_per_capita, y = Child_Mortality)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "darkgreen") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated GDP vs. Child Mortality (Strictly Decreasing)",
    x = "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
    y = "Child Mortality (per 1000 births)"
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "forestgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal()


```


```{r}
cor(df$GDP_per_capita, df$Child_Mortality)
```




```{r}
x <- rnorm(200)
y <- rnorm(200)
plot(x, y, pch = 20)
```


```{r}
cor(x, y)
```





```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Simulate ages from 18 to 36
age <- seq(18, 36, length.out = 100)

# Parabolic performance: peak at age 25, inverted U-shape
# R = -a*(age - 25)^2 + max_performance + noise
a <- 0.6
max_performance <- 100
performance <- -a * (age - 25)^2 + max_performance + rnorm(100, mean = 0, sd = 3)

# Create data frame
df <- data.frame(Age = age, Performance = performance)

# Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = Performance)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated Performance vs. Age of Soccer Player",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Performance (R)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
cor(df$Age, df$Performance)
```
